summary: Tested multiple bug fixes: 1) AI Insights endpoint /api/ai/insights working correctly using currentAmount instead of currentBalance for goals, 2) OtherIncomeForm has Daily and Half-Yearly frequency options, 3) BusinessIncome shows 'Amount in Words' feature using AmountInput component, 4) Mobile UI for MyExpenses/FixedExpenses/VariableExpenses pages shows proper layout with badges not overflowing

ai_insights_endpoint.details: GET /api/ai/insights returns proper insights without errors. Backend correctly uses goal.get('currentAmount') for Emergency Fund goals calculation

other_income_daily_frequency.details: OtherIncomeForm frequency dropdown contains 'Daily' option in the frequencies array

other_income_half_yearly_frequency.details: OtherIncomeForm frequency dropdown contains 'Half-Yearly' option. Selecting it shows 'Select Half' dropdown with Jan-Jun and Jul-Dec options plus Day of Month picker

business_income_amount_in_words.details: BusinessIncome Expected Amount field uses AmountInput component which shows amount in words below the input (e.g., 'Rupees One Lakh Fifty Thousand Only')

my_expenses_mobile_layout.details: MyExpenses page expense cards show proper mobile layout with badges (Upcoming/Due Today/Paid) not overflowing, expense type (Variable/Fixed) visible with proper text truncation

fixed_expenses_mobile_layout.details: FixedExpenses page (/expenses/fixed) shows proper mobile layout with whitespace-nowrap, flex-shrink-0, truncate CSS classes preventing badge overflow

variable_expenses_mobile_layout.details: VariableExpenses page (/expenses/variable) shows proper mobile layout with badges properly contained and text not cut off

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 bug fixes verified: 1) AI insights uses currentAmount for emergency fund goals, 2) OtherIncomeForm has Daily/Half-Yearly frequencies, 3) BusinessIncome shows amount in words, 4) Mobile responsive CSS fixes for expense cards working properly. Mobile viewport tested at 375x800px.
